晚上，王建新在医院食堂吃的晚餐。王建新和人打听后来到食堂，他才知道医院里有三个食堂，干部职工食堂干部有小灶，住院部还有病号食堂。还有应急小食堂，给晚上加班的医生配备的。高干病房还有高干小食堂。不光食堂多，吃的东西也好，供应充足，像什么红烧肉、肉菜之类的，种类很全。干部小灶更是品种繁多，普通医护的大锅饭，油水也足，肉菜、蔬菜、鸡蛋全都有。王建新没有去干部食堂吃小灶，他来到普通医护人员处排队，打

双剑之上，牵引着天地之间的强大气机，这一刻似乎这天之间只剩下那两柄剑。

只见，孤狼站在监控室的门口环视四周，目光所落之处，保安们无不低头。

匆匆走了十几日，行至一地，放眼而望去，山明水秀，青草葱葱，柳枝摇曳，让人感觉说不出的翠爽清新。

见到地藏门与罗煞门合作，乾驳页的神色变得很是难看，欲言又止，最后却还是没有讲出话来。

果不其然，他的判断是对的。纳雅和纳莎的确没有在这儿，除了这里之外，在更深处一些的地方，还有第二个战局。

迎面而来的樊未离左手拖着右手，双指击出一招指剑，五雷天心剑带着电闪雷鸣而去，竟是淹没在二十几条神龙之中。

然而所有攻击都没有落到风天幽的身上，钟正道三人只感觉撞上了铜墙铁壁，无形的屏障让他们无法前进分毫。反而是自己身上一阵阵吃痛，不知什么时候多了许多伤口。

“欧阳老贼，今日当着这么多人的面，更有藏剑山庄的二老爷独孤煌在，你安敢血口喷人！”端皇天玹怒斥。

叶凡摇头不语，他这么说就是想要让宋美美安静一点儿，不要问东问西，很显然没有起到应有的效果。

“这次我前来拜访糜家，不论成与不成，都将前往国都洛阳，觐见天子，还归族谱，并求取一差半职，倾我二十年的鬼谷一脉所学，为国效力，为民谋福。”刘天浩说的大义凌然。

三十多人突然出现在一个空旷寂静的废弃城市，除了他们之外，别说其他人，就连一条狗都没有。

“不好，再让他这么攻击下去，大阵迟早会被攻破的！”叶远神色凝重道。

叶仓转过身，靠在扶栏上，两缕棕色的鬓发垂落在脸庞边，随着海风飞舞着。

叶远是这么想的，毕竟，在这里天尊灵宝不值钱，连垃圾都不如。

首长的这段话的潜台词很多，王家兄弟都是明白人，自然个个都点头称是。

可是，如果不是还在抱着期待，还在试探她对自己是否有那么一丁点儿的在乎，又怎么可能有昨晚的烟花之夜？

这一幕幕是那么的熟悉，那么的让人感到亲切，可是今天之后她就看不到了。

听她夸其他男人，虽然是自己的亲弟弟，但心里还觉得相当的不舒服。

而一个身着紫色袍服，袍边有绣金边的中年人正坐在门口一个竹椅子上打着盹儿。

听到这句满是讽刺的话语，叶琳蓦地抬起头，不置信的看着面前那张让她怨恨了二十多年的素颜，苏曼柔，不，是苏暖暖，这个卑贱的丫头，竟与那个贱人长了一张同样魅惑众生的脸孔。

在这个阵法中，无论里面的人做什么事情，都不会被外面的人知道，更奇妙的是，这阵法还有隐蔽身形的作用，让人虚实难辨。这阵法也叫做御风点穴阵，着实玄妙。

过了一会，秦香才放下手里的针，坐了起来，身边的丫鬟赶紧凑过去想要扶她，却被她用手挡住了。

In the evening, Wang Jianxin had dinner in the hospital cafeteria.After Wang Jianxin inquired with others and went to the cafeteria, he learned that there were three cafeterias in the hospital, the cadres and staff cafeteria had a small stove, and there was also a patient cafeteria in the inpatient department.There is also an emergency canteen for doctors who work overtime at night.There is also a canteen for senior cadres in the ward.Not only are there many canteens, but the food is also good and the supply is sufficient. There is a wide variety of braised pork, meat dishes, etc.There are even more varieties in the cadre's small stove. A big pot of rice for ordinary medical staff, with enough oil and water, meat, vegetables, and eggs.Wang Jianxin did not go to the cadre canteen to eat Xiaozao. He queued up at the general medical staff and got a shot.

The two swords pulled the powerful energy between heaven and earth. At this moment, it seemed that only those two swords were left in the sky.

I saw Lone Wolf standing at the door of the monitoring room and looking around. Wherever his eyes fell, the security guards all lowered their heads.

After walking hurriedly for more than ten days, I arrived at a place where I could see beautiful mountains and clear waters, lush green grass and swaying willow branches, which made people feel indescribably green and fresh.

Seeing the cooperation between the Ksitigarbha Sect and the Luosha Sect, Qian Piye's expression became very ugly, and he hesitated to speak, but in the end he still could not speak.

Sure enough, his judgment was correct.Naya and Nasha are indeed not here. Apart from here, there is a second battle situation deeper.

Fan Weili, who was coming towards him, dragged his right hand with his left hand and made a sword move with two fingers. The Five Thunder Tianxin Sword went away with lightning and thunder, and was actually submerged in more than twenty divine dragons.

However, none of the attacks fell on Feng Tianyou. Zhong Zhengdao and the others only felt that they had hit a copper wall. The invisible barrier prevented them from moving forward at all.Instead, he felt pains all over his body, and he didn't know when he got a lot of wounds.

"Ouyang old thief, in front of so many people today, and even the second master of Hidden Sword Villa, Dugu Huang, is here, how dare you spit on others!" Duanhuang Tianxuan scolded angrily.

Ye Fan shook his head and said nothing. He said this because he wanted Song Meimei to be quiet and stop asking questions. Obviously, it did not have the desired effect.

"This time I come to visit the Mi family. Regardless of whether I succeed or not, I will go to the capital of Luoyang to meet the emperor, return the family tree, and ask for a job. I will use my twenty years of experience in Guigu to serve the country and benefit the people." Liu Tianhao said with great righteousness.

More than thirty people suddenly appeared in an empty and silent abandoned city. Apart from them, there was no one else, not even a dog.

"No, if we let him continue attacking like this, the formation will be broken sooner or later!" Ye Yuan said with a solemn expression.

Ye Cang turned around and leaned on the railing, with two strands of brown hair hanging down on his face, flying in the sea breeze.

Ye Yuan thought so. After all, the Tianzun Lingbao here was worthless, even worse than garbage.

There are many subtexts in the chief's words. The Wang brothers are all understanding people, so naturally they all nodded in agreement.

However, if she wasn't still holding on to expectations and testing whether she cared about him even a little bit, how could there have been last night's fireworks night?

This scene was so familiar and cordial, but she wouldn't be able to see it after today.

Hearing her praise other men, even though they are her biological brothers, still makes her feel quite uncomfortable.

And a middle-aged man wearing a purple robe with gold embroidery on the edge was sitting on a bamboo chair at the door and taking a nap.

Hearing these sarcastic words, Ye Lin suddenly raised her head and looked in disbelief at the plain face in front of her that she had resented for more than twenty years. Su Manrou, no, Su Nuannuan, this despicable girl, actually had the same charming face as that bitch.

In this formation, no matter what the people inside do, no one outside will know. What's even more amazing is that this formation also has the function of hiding the body shape, making it difficult to distinguish the true from the false.This formation is also called the Wind Control Point Formation, and it is truly mysterious.

After a while, Qin Xiang put down the needle in her hand and sat up. The maid next to her quickly moved over to help her, but she blocked her with her hand.
